entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A human planeswalker from Tolvada and ghost hunter who became guildmaster of the Orzhov Syndicate, joined the Gatewatch and killed Heliod.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who hired Kaya to kill the Obzedat and maneuvered her into becoming Orzhov guildmaster.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: An Orzhov leader who partnered with Kaya, ended the partnership and later usurped her position; assassinated in Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who worked with Kaya on Ravnica and activated the Interplanar Beacon.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari leader who pledged the Swarm against Bolas.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A Rakdos emissary killed on Ravnica and resurrected as a blood witch.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: An Orzhov representative who helped Kaya and later acted as guildmaster in her place.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A newly ignited planeswalker who became Kaya's companion.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A Gateless street urchin nicknamed Rat who travels with Kaya.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker condemned to death for the Dreadhorde, who later took the name Ana Iora.

entities.name: Zahid
entities.description: A djinn released from the sapphire amulet who sought vengeance.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor Kaya hunted on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: The God of the Cosmos who protected the party from Vorinclex.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Kaya on Kaldheim and joined the strike team.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A planeswalker who rallied trolls against Kaya and created a Doomskar.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: A demon who led demons through a rift and who was killed by Kaya.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: The leader of the Omenseekers of Bretagard who joined Kaya's party.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker with whom Kaya saved each other's lives on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: A god or captain who saved Kaya from Varragoth.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A compleated Theros god killed by Kaya.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker who asked the Gatewatch for help finding the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped on Innistrad and installed the Temporal Anchor.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who helped on Innistrad.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire who held the Moonsilver Key and joined a pact against Olivia.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who took the Moonsilver Key, beginning the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who stopped Sorin's attack and was freed from the Key.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who extracted the Sylex information from Kaya and was stabbed by Elspeth.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who stabbed Jace and seized the Sylex.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker on the strike team who left with Kaya to defend Kamigawa.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor who invited the strike team to join Phyrexia.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker newly compleated who was sent to conquer Zendikar.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective who investigated the Karlov Manor murders with Kaya.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: An inspector who became Kaya's assistant.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir agent captured and later freed in the investigation.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: A dryad of Trostani who orchestrated the murders in retribution for traitors during the invasion.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: The chief of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations who invited Kaya to lead the investigation.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The Orzhov Ghost Council that Kaya killed.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose guildmaster Kaya became.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker alliance Kaya joined.

entities.name: Tolvada
entities.description: Kaya's homeplane with a cracked sky.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane where Kaya took assassination contracts.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Kaya led the Orzhov.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane where Kaya hunted Vorinclex.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: A Kaldheim realm where Kaya's party fought.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: A Kaldheim realm where Tibalt created a Doomskar.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane of the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of Urza's Tower and Caligo.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane the strike team infiltrated.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane Kaya defended with Kaito.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane where Kaya killed Heliod.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's homeplane.

entities.name: Orzhova
entities.description: The Orzhov guild's cathedral-city on Ravnica.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya guildhall on Ravnica.

entities.name: Seedcore
entities.description: The place on New Phyrexia where Realmbreaker grew.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: An Innistrad artifact needed to restore the balance of night and day.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: The artifact the strike team meant to detonate.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: New Phyrexia's World Tree that opened paths to other planes.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of the Multiverse by New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: The cataclysm on Kaldheim triggered by Tibalt.

events.summary: Bolas promises to heal Tolvada's sky in return for Kaya's help killing the Obzedat.
events.quote: he had promised her he would heal the sky in return for her assistance in killing the Obzedat on Ravnica

events.summary: Kaya discovers Emilio Revari murdered his mother and leaves him to her ghost.
events.quote: she uncovered the reality that Emilio was directly responsible for his mother's death

events.summary: Kaya assassinates the ghostly King Brago.
events.quote: she successfully infiltrated Brago's dining room and plunged her rondel dagger into his spectral neck

events.summary: Bolas hires Kaya to kill the Obzedat and become Orzhov guildmaster.
events.quote: Bolas hired her to kill the Obzedat and become guildmaster of Orzhov

events.summary: Kaya kills the Ghost Council and becomes guildmaster through a loophole.
events.quote: she had become the new guildmaster of the Syndicate

events.summary: Kaya frees many people from Orzhov debts, causing Teysa to end their partnership.
events.quote: caused Teysa to end their partnership

events.summary: Kaya attends the guild summit and witnesses its dissolution after the murder of Isperia.
events.quote: Kaya and Teysa attended the guild summit on behalf of the Orzhov, and witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia

events.summary: Kaya turns the tables, has Teysa arrested and offers the hierarchs a deal.
events.quote: She turned the tables, had Teysa arrested, and offered the hierarchs a deal

events.summary: Bolas brings the Immortal Sun to Ravnica, trapping planeswalkers, and Kaya defects from him for good.
events.quote: Once the Beacon was active, Bolas brought the Immortal Sun to Ravnica, trapping the planeswalkers there

events.summary: Kaya befriends Teyo and fights Bolas's forces with Araithia and Ral.
events.quote: Alongside many other planeswalkers and Ravnicans, Kaya fought against Bolas' forces

events.summary: The Orzhov triumvirate agrees to join the fight against Bolas.
events.quote: Swayed by Bilagru's arguments, the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

events.summary: Trostani awakens and the Selesnya agree to help the Gatewatch; Araithia wins over the Gruul.
events.quote: Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

events.summary: Vraska pledges the Golgari to the fight against Bolas.
events.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas

events.summary: The Rakdos resurrect Hekara as a blood witch.
events.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

events.summary: Kaya represents the Orzhov in a ritual to restore the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Kaya served as the representative for the Orzhov Syndicate

events.summary: Kaya joins the Gatewatch to atone and is assigned to assassinate Liliana Vess.
events.quote: Seeking to atone for her past mistakes, she joined the Gatewatch

events.summary: Tomik finds a loophole letting Kaya transfer her Orzhov contracts to him so she can planeswalk.
events.quote: Tomik Vrona discovered a legal loophole that allowed Kaya to temporarily transfer her Orzhov contracts and guild responsibilities to him

events.summary: Liliana agrees to let Kaya kill her in exchange for defeating her imposter.
events.quote: Liliana regained consciousness and agreed to let Kaya kill her in exchange for defeating her imposter and freeing her people

events.summary: Rat destroys the sapphire amulet, releasing the djinn Zahid.
events.quote: Rat stole the sapphire amulet and destroyed it, which released the djinn named Zahid

events.summary: Kaya kills the imposter Liliana out of mercy.
events.quote: Kaya killed the mistress out of mercy

events.summary: Liliana gives up the Chain Veil, which is delivered as proof of her death.
events.quote: Teyo suggested that Liliana give up the Veil, which she reluctantly did

events.summary: Kaya's group meets Liliana, now called Ana Iora, on Fiora.
events.quote: Liliana, who had changed her name to Ana Iora

events.summary: Kaya and Inga's party engage Vorinclex in Aldergard and Alrund reveals himself.
events.quote: the party engaged Vorinclex

events.summary: Kaya exposes Tibalt behind the troll gathering and escapes with Tyvar's help.
events.quote: She quickly saw through the disguise and revealed the planeswalker Tibalt doing his dirty work

events.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar before Kaya and Tyvar can take the Sword of the Realms from him.
events.quote: they were unable to prevent Tibalt from creating a Doomskar before they managed to take the sword from him

events.summary: Kaya kills the demon Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe.
events.quote: the demon was only stopped by Kaya, who cut the demon's throat with one of the axes Tyvar had made for her

events.summary: Kaya and Niko save each other's lives in battle.
events.quote: Niko and Kaya ended up saving each other's lives during the battle

events.summary: Tyvar praises Kaya for killing Varragoth after the Doomskar ends.
events.quote: Tyvar met Kaya and praised her for killing Varragoth

events.summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help Arlinn find the Moonsilver Key.
events.quote: The three planeswalkers agree to help Arlin and head to Innistrad

events.summary: Kaya kills ghosts in the Betzold mansion until she finds Dennick's spirit.
events.quote: Kaya entered the ruins alone and killed the ghosts of the place until she found the spirit of Dennick Betzold

events.summary: Sigarda appears and stops Sorin's attack so the party can take the Key.
events.quote: Sigarda appeared, answering a prayer made by the group before entering the Manor, and stopped the attack

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren takes the Key, beginning the Eternal Night.
events.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared and interrupted the ritual by taking the Key with her

events.summary: The party forms a pact with Sorin and travels to Olivia's wedding.
events.quote: They formed a pact with Sorin and traveled together to the wedding of Olivia and Edgar Markov at the Voldaren estate

events.summary: Kaya frees imprisoned spirits in the Voldaren manor and the balance of night and day is restored.
events.quote: The ritual was completed, and the balance between night and day was restored

events.summary: Kaya allows Jace to telepathically extract the Sylex information from her.
events.quote: she allowed Jace Beleren to telepathically extract this information from her

events.summary: Kaya joins the strike team to infiltrate New Phyrexia and destroy Realmbreaker.
events.quote: Kaya joined the strike team that was to infiltrate New Phyrexia and detonate the Sylex to destroy Realmbreaker

events.summary: Kaya and Kaito try to interrupt Jace's detonation; Elspeth impales Jace and seizes the Sylex.
events.quote: burst into the chamber, impaled Jace with her Halo-infused blade, and seized the Sylex, planeswalking away

events.summary: Kaya defies Elesh Norn's invitation to join Phyrexia as the invasion begins.
events.quote: Kaya defiantly told her to go to hell as the interplanar invasion began

events.summary: Kaya leaves with Kaito to defend Kamigawa.
events.quote: Kaya left with Kaito to defend Kamigawa

events.summary: Kaya kills the compleated Heliod by climbing him and cutting his throat.
events.quote: the compleated Heliod was distracted enough to be killed by Kaya, who climbed him and cut his throat

events.summary: Teysa Karlov usurps Kaya's position as Orzhov guildmaster while Kaya defends the Multiverse.
events.quote: Kaya retained her spark through the Desparkening

events.summary: Kaya helps Alquist Proft expose and capture the Dimir agent Etrata after Zegana's assassination.
events.quote: Kaya assisted the detective Alquist Proft in investigating the case, helping to expose and capture the Dimir agent Etrata

events.summary: Kaya agrees to lead the investigation into the murders with Kellan as her assistant.
events.quote: She accepted Chief of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations Ezrim 's invitation to lead the investigation into the murders

events.summary: Aurelia gives Kaya 24 hours to reveal the mastermind before Boros declares war on the Rakdos.
events.quote: Kaya was given 24 hours to reveal the mastermind behind the murders

events.summary: Kaya, Kellan and Ezrim subdue the rampaging god Anzrag.
events.quote: The duo, along with Ezrim, subdued the god and returned him to containment

events.summary: Kaya defends herself from Oba and helps trap her in an Agency barrier ward.
events.quote: managed with the help of Etrata and the ghost of Teysa to trap Oba in an Agency barrier ward
